record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare THIEF: Nickit (1 star) and Thievul (2 stars); both maxPP 100, range 2, no declared passive. The strategy is shared; the only unit difference is the star count (table index).

dispatch.note: No overrides: the base defaults apply (target required, crit only with the ABILITY_CRIT effect). The target is dereferenced without a null check (target.items), so the cast relies on the normal target gate.

record.summary: After spending PP, the caster first takes every item the target holds and only then damages it. For each item in target.items the strategy calls caster.addItem(item) and then target.removeItem(item) unconditionally, so an item the caster cannot take (caster already holds 3 items, holds a Synergy Stone of a type it already has, Eviolite/Rare Candy without an evolution, Rare Candy while holding Eviolite, or already holds that item) is still REMOVED from the target and simply lost. Items are moved on the live entity only (permanent flag false: the player's board Pokemon items are not changed by this code). The theft happens even if the target is then protected / skydiving / Magic Bounced. Afterwards target.handleSpecialDamage(raw 15/30/60/120 by caster stars, board, SPECIAL, caster, crit) is applied: requested amount x (1 + caster AP/100) (apBoost default true), x critPower if the cast crit (reduced by the target's Rocky Helmet or Black Augurite - but the target's items were already stolen at that point, so a stolen Rocky Helmet no longer negates the crit), then PokemonState.handleDamage resolves the defences (special defence), shields and the minimum of 1.

targeting.who: the single enemy target the unit is attacking (range 2 for both units)
targeting.note: The target comes from the normal attack target; no area, no secondary targets.

declaredRaw.note: all items the target holds (up to 3), in SetSchema iteration order

effects.resolution: For each item: addItem(item) on the caster, then removeItem(item) on the target regardless of whether addItem accepted it. addItem silently returns when the caster has 3 items, when item is a Synergy Stone whose type the caster already has, when it is Eviolite/Rare Candy and the caster's board Pokemon has no evolution, or Rare Candy while the caster holds Eviolite; if the caster already holds the same item nothing is added but the target's copy is still removed. A gained item applies its ItemStats and effects via applyItemEffect (and adds its synergy type, with simulation.applySynergyEffects); the removed item reverses its stats/effects/types on the target via removeItemEffect. The list is modified while it is iterated (SetSchema.forEach with delete); the iteration behaviour of that class was not read, see unresolved.

effects.scaling: requested = table value. handleSpecialDamage: x(1 + AP/100) of the caster (apBoost true); x2 if the caster has DOUBLE_DAMAGE (consumed); x1.2 with the Strange Steam board effect on either unit; if crit, x(1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor) with the factor 1 reduced to 0 by Rocky Helmet (checked after the steal, so only items the target still has) and by 0.1 per Black Augurite of the target's player (not for TRUE damage); then PokemonState.handleDamage.
effects.resolution: requested (raw table) -> applied special damage (after the AP/crit/steam factors) -> handleDamage: special defence reduction, shields, minimum of 1 (reducedDamage = min(1)(ceil(...))) -> takenDamage (includes shield damage). The ability does not use the returned value. If the target is protected, skydiving or has Magic Bounce, handleSpecialDamage returns takenDamage 0 and no damage is dealt (Magic Bounce may reflect after 500 ms unless the caster holds Protective Pads), but the items were already taken. Power Lens on the target (if it still holds it - it was stolen first) would reflect damage blocked by special defence; since all items are removed beforehand this branch cannot trigger from this cast's target unless the item was added back by an effect. See core-mechanics.md sections A and H.

buffs.effect: the caster gains the stolen items' stats and effects (through addItem/applyItemEffect), limited by addItem's refusals

starBehavior.note: Indexed by the casting entity's stars; 60 and 120 are not reached at the bare factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond the cast gate: single target, no cell or distance condition inside the effect.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. A repeat cast steals whatever the (possibly different) target holds at that time; a target without items just takes the damage.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw damage 15/30 (1/2 stars) is the requested amount; applied = raw x (1 + AP/100) x double-damage / steam / crit factors; the resolved HP loss is after special defence, shield and the minimum of 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Items: the amount stolen is the target's whole item set (requested), but the caster keeps only what addItem accepts; the rest is destroyed for this fight.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
Individual item effect bodies (ItemEffects) applied or reversed on steal were not traced item by item; shared references: knowledge/07367c34/item-effects.md

Whether the damage target can be null/dead when process runs (target gate not re-read for this record)
The mutual order of the item theft and Cover Band / ally redirection inside handleDamage was not traced; the ability uses neither returned value
Whether the two units ever reach a different star count than the factory value
